name: Katsuragi (Nara, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Katsuragi city emblem in red and green: a red ring above green leaves and a green ring.
history: Municipal flag of Katsuragi, a city in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 19 February 2005.

features.role: Katsuragi city emblem — a red ring above green leaves and a green ring
